in_marathi.name: Jeewan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lively, Living, Existence
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jeewan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jeewan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Jiva’ which means ‘living being’ or ‘existence’. It is a powerful name that represents the essence of life and the eternal spirit within us.
